skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop the ability to reason logically and construct mathematical proofs.
Understand and apply concepts of sets, functions, and relations.
Design and analyze algorithms, including recursive algorithms.
Apply principles of counting, permutations, and combinations to solve problems.
Analyze and solve problems using graph theory concepts.
Understand and apply concepts of trees and their applications.
Apply mathematical concepts to solve practical problems such as encryption, shortest path, graph coloring, and minimum spanning trees.
Develop the ability to learn independently and work in groups.
Enhance critical thinking and analytical skills in mathematical contexts.
Work effectively in teams and take responsibility for group projects.
